title: My Europe Journey a luxury 5-star operation
text:
In planning our recent itinerary for 6 nights in Barcelona, we sought a high level, professional, exceedingly reliable transportation outfit.  We needed both local services, to get to as many of the Barcelona  places of importance expeditiously, along with full day drives to Girona and Figueres.
My Europe Journey far surpassed our expectations!
Our drivers were not only highly competent, but also 
professional, timely and patient. A special shout out to Andrei, who accompanied us, took care of us, on several ventures.
